Subject:
steps.copy: 2026 NEPDA Website Design & Development RFQ Response — Hirobius

steps.text: Body:
steps.copy:
Hi Kelly,

I'm a Spokane-based design systems engineer and only just saw the NEPDA website RFQ, after the September 20 deadline. Is the selection still open to a late statement of qualifications? If so, I can have a 5–7 page SOQ to you within three business days, including a recommended CMS, a phased fee proposal within the $20,000 target, and optional hosting and maintenance pricing.

If the window has closed, no problem, and I'd be glad to be considered for future work.

Thanks,
Adrian Milsap
Hirobius
adrian@hirobius.com
